text: K3 quotes Carter's account of opening Tutankhamun's tomb. His book, letter after letter from some starting point, could be K4's key, with the alphabet in any order.
At every starting letter, forwards and backwards, each known letter gives an equation about the alphabet alone; a compiled search decides all 24 exactly, on K4 and ten scrambled copies.

No starting letter fits K4 or any copy; 953 of about 1.7 million stay undecided. With two unknown alphabets the equations leave almost no checks, for any book: the known letters cannot decide that case.
